clue.text: Premonition of honour by Attila

parts.note: Attila was king of the Huns
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: A forewarning that Attila the Hun is about to be decorated.
explanation.definitionFit: A hunch is a gut feeling about what will happen, an intuition or foreboding.

clue.text: Causes of insomnia for Gilbert's Chancellor

definitions.text: Causes of insomnia for Gilbert's Chancellor

parts.words: Causes of insomnia for Gilbert's Chancellor
parts.note: the Lord Chancellor in Gilbert and Sullivan's Iolanthe sings a nightmare song about lying awake with a pain in the head

explanation.surface: What kept the Lord Chancellor of the operetta awake at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Pains in the head keep the sleepless Lord Chancellor of Iolanthe from rest.

clue.text: This-old coin buys no French wheat

parts.note: ble is French for wheat

explanation.surface: An antique coin cannot buy any wheat in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The coin was an old English gold piece.
explanation.definitionFit: An old English gold coin went by this name, worth a third of a pound.

clue.text: French wine and the ale make this Swiss tipsy

indicators.note: tipsy implies the letters are staggering about drunkenly

parts.note: vin is French for wine

explanation.surface: Wine and beer make a Swiss man drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Helvetia is the Latin name for Switzerland, so this adjective means Swiss.

clue.text: Overseer that is involved with coppers

indicators.note: involved suggests letters tangled up together, so the pieces are rearranged

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A supervisor who gets mixed up with the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A periscope lets a submariner look over the surface, a playful sense of something that oversees.

clue.text: Writer with weapon bags 'one bird

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument

indicators.note: bags means holds inside, so one piece contains another

parts.note: a gun is a weapon
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An armed author grabs a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Writer' is the instrument, not the author.
explanation.definitionFit: This flightless seabird of the southern hemisphere is a bird.

clue.text: Bringing in fish in Wagner's operas ?

indicators.note: in places the fish within the name of the opera cycle

parts.note: Wagner's Ring cycle is four operas
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: Landing a fish in the middle of a Wagner opera.
explanation.definitionFit: An angler winding in a catch is said to be pulling it in with the line on a spool.

clue.text: Only about a hundred at the column's base

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word goes round another

parts.note: sole means only
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Barely a hundred people at the foot of a column.
explanation.definitionFit: A plinth or low block at the foot of a column or pedestal.

clue.text: A " thing "'various bosses have on one perhaps

indicators.note: various suggests differing arrangements of the letters

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Bosses fixate on one worker.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a thing about something means an obsession with it, colloquially.

clue.text: No difficulty getting money for artist's support

parts.note: ease means lack of difficulty
L stands for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Easily getting funds to back an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter's stand holding the canvas is the artist's support.

clue.text: Might it be called for by a doctor with a top class instrument?

definitions.text: Might it be called for by a doctor with a top class instrument?

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree
U means upper class in British usage
a lance is a surgical blade, also called a lancet

explanation.surface: A doctor with a smart scalpel summons emergency transport.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay: a doctor might call for the vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor sends for an emergency vehicle to take a patient to hospital.

clue.text: Suits syntactical relationships

definitions.meaning: lawsuits, legal actions brought in court
in grammar, nominative, accusative and so on show a noun's role

explanation.definitionFit: Legal actions are called this in court, and grammar uses the same word for a noun's inflected role.

clue.text: Ridge in bare terrain

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words bare terrain

explanation.surface: A ridge stands out in a barren landscape.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp mountain crest between two glacial valleys is called this.

clue.text: Kind of joint found in all 10

definitions.meaning: a type of coupling allowing rotation in any direction
10 across is CASES, and something found in all cases applies everywhere

explanation.definitionFit: A coupling joint in mechanics bears this name, and something present in every instance is all-embracing.

clue.text: Such coarse cloth as is formed into a layer

indicators.note: into places the rearranged letters within the bird

parts.note: a hen is a bird that lays eggs

indicators.note: formed means shaped anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Describing how a rough fabric is made into a layer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'layer' is not a stratum but an egg-layer, HEN; 'formed' rearranges AS IS to SSIA, which goes 'into' HEN.
explanation.definitionFit: This sacking or burlap is a coarse fabric woven from jute or hemp.

clue.text: Demoralized when head outfitter in south-east died

indicators.note: in places the hat-maker within the compass direction

parts.note: a hatter outfits heads

explanation.surface: Gloom after a chief clothier died in the south-east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head outfitter' looks like a chief clothier but is a supplier of headwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Utterly broken in spirit or exhausted is a sense of demoralised.

clue.text: Birds divine beings without intelligence

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: gods are divine beings
wit means intelligence or good sense

explanation.surface: Deities lacking any brains.
explanation.definitionFit: These are long-billed wading birds related to sandpipers.

clue.text: Very severe is Dr Scot about a swindle

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: DR, doctor, taken as written
Ian is a typical Scottish name
a con is a swindle

explanation.surface: A Scottish doctor surrounds a fraud with harsh penalties.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after the harsh Athenian lawgiver Draco, it means extremely harsh.

clue.text: Dogs diving off boards?

definitions.meaning: spaniels of a breed used to flush game

explanation.definitionFit: Spaniels of this breed flush game, and the word also suggests those who leap off springboards.

clue.text: Instead badly marked

indicators.note: badly signals the word Instead is disordered into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Something was poorly graded rather than well.
explanation.definitionFit: Something soiled or blotted has been marked.

clue.text: Makes resolution-thirteenth December

parts.note: the Ides fall on the thirteenth in most months of the Roman calendar

explanation.surface: Making a New Year's resolution in mid-December.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming to a firm resolution means settling on a choice.

clue.text: Twister gives odds to girl ? Right …

parts.note: SP is starting price, the betting odds at a race's start
Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A tornado lays betting odds for a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: SP is a British betting term, the starting price offered on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrench is a tool for twisting nuts, so it is a twister.

clue.text: Orchestral part Pinocchio dispensed with

definitions.meaning: the violins, violas, cellos and basses section
the puppet came to life without the cords a marionette hangs from

explanation.definitionFit: The violin section of an orchestra, and the cords a puppet like Pinocchio did without.

clue.text: . or possibly right, if I trace this craftsman

indicators.note: or possibly suggests another arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, a skilled worker traces something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or possibly' rearranges R and IF I TRACE.
explanation.definitionFit: An artisan or skilled mechanic is a craftsman.

clue.text: A scholar and artist in Iraq

parts.note: MA is Master of Arts, a scholar
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A learned man and a painter in Iraq.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a city on the Tigris in south-east Iraq.

clue.text: As — as dicers' oaths" (Hamlet)

parts.note: a gap in Hamlet's line to his mother, comparing marriage vows to gamblers' worthless oaths

explanation.surface: A quotation from Hamlet with a word missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet compares marriage vows to gamblers' oaths, which are untrue.

clue.text: Frequently decimal

definitions.meaning: read as two words, ..., the base of decimal counting

explanation.definitionFit: It means many times, and split into two words describes a number system based on ten.

clue.text: Nasal tone from Bow?

definitions.meaning: a nasal quality of the voice
the sound of a plucked bowstring

explanation.definitionFit: A nasal accent in speech, and the vibrating sound a released bowstring makes.

clue.text: Proud-pied —, dressed in all his trim" (Shakespeare)

definitions.text: Proud-pied —, dressed in all his trim" (Shakespeare)

parts.words: Proud-pied —, dressed in all his trim" (Shakespeare)
parts.note: a gap in a line from Shakespeare's Sonnet 98 describing a spring month in finery

explanation.surface: A quotation from a Shakespeare sonnet with a word missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Sonnet 98 opens with this spring month, gaily coloured and dressed in finery.

clue.text: Scottish castle found by Scotus, empty

parts.note: Duns Scotus was the medieval philosopher
inane means empty or vacuous

explanation.surface: A Scottish castle discovered by the philosopher to be deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: Macbeth's fortress in Shakespeare's play is a Scottish castle.

clue.text: Hats, tiaras etc he dropped where people live

indicators.note: dropped means the letters of the word he are taken away

parts.note: headdresses are hats, tiaras and other things worn on the head

explanation.surface: A man let fall his hats and tiaras at people's homes.
explanation.definitionFit: Places where people live are their homes, known by street and number.

clue.text: Abyssinia's Number One -wine drink

definitions.meaning: the title of the emperor of Ethiopia
a hot drink of port or sherry with sugar and spice

explanation.definitionFit: It was the Ethiopian emperor's title and is also a hot spiced port punch.
